items.title: FDC Putman (Netherlands) claimed by LockBit 5.0
items.summary: Dutch firm FDC Putman was listed as a victim by the LockBit 5.0 ransomware group on September 9, 2026.

items.title: Contreras Hermanos S.A. (Argentina) claimed by LockBit 5.0
items.summary: Argentine company Contreras Hermanos S.A. was named on the LockBit 5.0 leak site on September 9, 2026.

items.title: EMS1 (USA) claimed by Direwolf
items.summary: US emergency-services media/data firm EMS1 was listed as a Direwolf ransomware victim on September 9, 2026.

items.title: Brent Electric Inc. (USA) claimed by Akira
items.summary: US electrical contractor Brent Electric Inc. was named on the Akira ransomware leak site on September 9, 2026.

items.title: Brentwood Country Club (USA) claimed by Akira
items.summary: Brentwood Country Club in the US was listed as an Akira ransomware victim on September 9, 2026.

items.title: Kido International nursery chain cyberattack fallout continues
items.summary: The UK/international nursery chain Kido International remains a reference case this cycle after attackers stole and briefly published data on young children to pressure the company.

ransomware.note: Named-victim detail this cycle skewed toward leak-site listings (LockBit 5.0, Akira, Direwolf) dated September 9; per-incident write-ups had not yet been published for most.

items.title: Azure East US outage disrupted ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok
items.summary: An Azure East US outage on September 3, 2026 caused roughly 90 minutes of simultaneous disruption to ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok, illustrating shared hyperscaler-region dependency risk across unrelated SaaS vendors.

outage.note: No new named multi-service cloud outage surfaced in the past two weeks beyond the September 3 Azure East US incident; analyst trackers continue to flag AWS us-east-1, Azure, and Google Cloud as elevated-risk regions for 2026.

items.title: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center auth bypass added to KEV
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-20079 (CVSS 10.0), an authentication bypass in Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center allowing unauthenticated root access, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a September 12 federal patch deadline.

items.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway auth bypass added to KEV
items.summary: CVE-2026-19490 (CVSS 9.3), an authentication bypass in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, was added to the CISA KEV catalog alongside the Cisco and Fortinet flaws, with a September 12 federal patch deadline.

items.title: Cisco ISE zero-day under active exploitation
items.summary: CISA flagged active exploitation of a Cisco Identity Services Engine zero-day enabling root-privilege command execution, urging federal agencies to patch within three days.

items.title: Seven more exploited flaws added to CISA KEV (SonicWall, Artifactory, Switchvox, Starlette, Kestra, LiteLLM)
items.summary: CISA added seven actively exploited vulnerabilities spanning SonicWall, JFrog Artifactory, Sangoma Switchvox, Starlette, Kestra, and LiteLLM to its KEV catalog after real-world attacker use.

items.title: Node.js RAT campaign exploits weaponized flaw, ~3,000 IPs targeted
items.summary: A malicious campaign weaponized a recently disclosed flaw to deliver a feature-rich Node.js remote access trojan, with an estimated 3,000+ IP addresses targeted and 178 devices confirmed infected.

items.title: FEMA major disaster declaration for Colorado (wildfires, flooding, mudslides)
items.summary: A presidential major disaster declaration for public assistance was issued for Colorado on September 1, 2026, covering wildfire, flooding, and mudslide damage from an incident period of June 27–July 29, 2026.

items.title: FEMA major disaster declaration amended for Texas (severe storms, tornadoes, flooding)
items.summary: A Texas major disaster declaration for severe storms, straight-line winds, tornadoes, and flooding (incident period July 12–August 4, 2026) was issued September 1 and amended September 9 and September 14, 2026.

items.title: M 6.5 earthquake, 126 km NNE of Teluknaga, Indonesia
items.summary: A magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck 126 km NNE of Teluknaga, Indonesia on September 11, 2026; USGS listed no tsunami threat and a green alert.

physical.note: Search results for active September hurricane/typhoon/wildfire events were thin; the FEMA declarations above cover damage incident periods from earlier in the summer but were formally declared/amended this month.
